process: Tips & referrals in → automatic structuring of each new tip
kind: Ensemble: TF-IDF (word + char n-grams) → logistic regression + local sentence encoder (bge-small-en-v1.5, frozen) → logistic regression; 9 scheme types

held_out.note: Test tips use sentence templates and provider names never seen in training.

use: Classifies every new tip offline; an LLM (if enabled) adds entity extraction and summaries. Supervisors triage every tip.
limitations: Synthetic tips are short and templated; real tips are messier.
Urgency is keyword/LLM-based: a trained urgency model failed its held-out test (v1) and is not shipped.
Never decides anything — a tip is an allegation, not evidence.
name: tip_triage
